issues.legal_issue: The statutory scheme and lease terms did not require the Corporation to convey the leased premises to the lessee upon expiry of the lease.
The statutory requirement to convey premises at the lessee’s cost is conditional, and does not create an automatic right to conveyance irrespective of the lease terms and statutory context.
The lessee’s failure to pay the costs associated with conveyance meant it had not fulfilled the conditions required to claim conveyance.
A writ petition seeking conveyance filed after prolonged and unexplained delay, particularly after the petitioner failed to pursue a timely statutory civil suit, is liable to dismissal for laches.
A writ petition under Article 226 should not be entertained where the petitioner had an available civil remedy and used the writ proceeding to evade the limitation applicable to that remedy.
